summary.scope: Fixed VQ1 direct arena, three -0.5m and two +0.5m starts; not an official qualification or a reliability guarantee.

calibration_audit.unresolved_dependency: Command-model thrust and drag constants were estimated previously from privileged native reports.
calibration_audit.source_statement: Native reported actuator outputs, pose and attitude aligned by their own boot timestamps.
priors: Upright-gate vertical edges for roll/pitch correction
Fixed vehicle thrust and drag calibration
calibration_audit.required_fix: Identify thrust/drag from public camera measurements, public gyro/IMU and own sent commands; hold out whole flights. Do not fit against fused velocity produced by the old privileged-derived model. Replay the fit after removing native data, then repeat native control.

keep: Compact numerical traces and automatic plots
architecture_review.estimator_gap: Delayed attitude corrections rotate orientation history but do not repropagate historical position/velocity through the corrected dynamics. State corrections and the frozen gate anchor are not one jointly consistent estimate.
architecture_review.timing_gap: Arrival-envelope sensor clock alignment is not measured exposure time. Median camera velocity measurement age is about0.48s and is delayed-corrected; its motion-model error still matters during acceleration.
architecture_review.planning_gap: Current recovery brakes toward zero forward speed and hands off with fixed thresholds. It does not predict future visibility or crossing uncertainty.
architecture_review.metric_correction: Having a number for each block is necessary instrumentation, not proof of optimality. End-to-end flight constraints must include uncertainty and predicted gate-crossing margin; block errors may correlate.

numerical_feasibility.metric_source: Native poses used only for retrospective scoring and feasibility accounting.
numerical_feasibility.caveat: Kinematic lower bounds omit acceleration, turns and sensing stops. Earlier plots used gate-center path length, which is a nominal route and not a rigorous shortest-path bound.

next_checkpoints.name: Public-data dynamics calibration
next_checkpoints.success: No native fields in model identification; whole-flight held-out camera velocity-change RMS <=0.5m/s over0.5s windows (proposed target); 5/5 full flights from both shifted starts and exact poisoned replay.

next_checkpoints.name: Consistent timed estimator
next_checkpoints.success: Shared p,v,attitude,gate and model-bias history; replay delayed corrections causally; report innovation and crossing-error coverage. Test known injected sensor offsets and loss intervals without native control inputs.
next_checkpoints.reason: High-speed control must act on an uncertainty estimate that includes timing and model error.

next_checkpoints.success: At6m/s, halve measured horizontal-below1m/s time from4.442s to<=2.221s; 5/5 six-gate flights with zero contacts/resets. Publish crossing margins and sensor loss; then expand speeds.
